entry.title: Resolution 579 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR A WIDE-FORMAT COLOR DIGITAL IMAGING SYSTEM TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an estimated monthly cost of $340, to be used by the department’s Administration and Property Management Divisions in Hilo.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 579-26 - 06/03/26
